verdict.rationale: Docs mention a console dashboard for managing 'projects, API keys, usage, billing, and team access' (cerebras-docs-35), implying basic key issuance and team-level access controls, but there's no evidence of fine-grained/least-privilege scoping (e.g., per-agent permissions, read-only or model-restricted keys). missing for 10: explicit scoped/role-based API key permissions, per-agent credential restrictions, documentation on limiting key capabilities.
